data.body:
FINAL VERIFICATION - all acceptance criteria met, including the previously-known-risky mcp_registry job.

release.yml run: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33290369748 - ALL jobs succeeded, including Publish to MCP Registry (the job that failed on 0.13.0).

- PyPI: nava_rebar-0.13.1 wheel + sdist present at pypi.org/simple/nava-rebar/, PEP 740 attestation verified OK via pypi-attestations against the downloaded wheel (repository=https://github.com/navapbc/rebar).
- GitHub Release: v0.13.1 published, marked Latest, at https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/releases/tag/v0.13.1.
- MCP Registry: io.github.navapbc/rebar now reports version 0.13.1 with isLatest=true, status=active. This resolves the exact failure mode that blocked 0.13.0's MCP Registry entry (0.12.0 had been isLatest until now).
- Homebrew tap: manually dispatched the Autobump formula from PyPI workflow (run https://github.com/navapbc/homebrew-rebar/actions/runs/33290636554) since the scheduled poll predated the publish; formula now points at nava_rebar-0.13.1.tar.gz with matching sha256, confirmed via the GitHub Contents API.
- Channel install smoke test: fresh venv, pip install of nava-rebar with the mcp extra pinned to 0.13.1 resolves and installs cleanly from PyPI; rebar.__version__ reports 0.13.1.
- scripts/probe_rebar.py run against the freshly channel-installed binary (isolated temp tracker): 142 passed, 0 failed.

Gerrit change 2407 merged cleanly (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments) as commit 5ae9eb72b86b7d2119872ab5b578e635175185ce on main.

No exceptions needed this release - every acceptance criterion, including the previously-blocked MCP Registry AC, is fully satisfied. Closing the ticket.
